issues.concern: The English translation misrepresents the Japanese. '不愉快な気分になった' means 'I became displeased/unpleasant' or 'I felt unpleasant', not 'I was in an unpleasant mood.' The latter implies the mood itself was unpleasant, not that the speaker felt unpleasant.
issues.suggestion: Change to 'I felt unpleasant.' or 'I became displeased.'
